The '''TIE/sh shuttle''', also known as the '''TIE Command Shuttle''', was a model of [[armor]]ed [[shuttle]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] for the [[Galactic Empire]]. It was designed to [[transport]] [[Imperial officer]]s plus a [[squad]] of [[stormtrooper]]s between [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TIE OWM" /> [[Captain]] [[Lorth Needa]] of the Imperial [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Avenger]]'' made his final [[Realspace|space]] voyage aboard such a [[Starship|ship]] to the ''[[Executor]]'' before being [[Death|executed]] by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:TIECommandShuttleAft-TFOWM.png|thumb|left|250px|Aft view of a TIE shuttle]]
The TIE/sh shuttle made use of a two-pod configuration: the starboard pod served as the cockpit, and the portside pod carried passengers, protected by heavy armor plating. Beneath each pod were deflector shield generators, a rarity among TIE models. For additional defense, the shuttle was also equipped with two [[laser cannon]]s, mounted on the underside between the two pods.<ref name="TIE OWM" />

The passenger pod was accessible by either a docking hatch from the front or a retractable ramp from below. The shuttle was fitted with comfortable padded seats, refrigerated food and drinks, and a [[refresher]].<ref name="TIE OWM" />

The wings of the TIE/sh were bent outward to fulfill Imperial officers' requests for a design distinct from the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE bomber]]. Its wider profile made it difficult to dock in hangars designed for other twin-pod TIEs, so it normally docked in larger hangars reserved for officers. The wings were fitted with extra armor plating, but the armor was relatively light to allow the ship to keep pace with TIE bombers and [[TIE boarding craft]].<ref name="TIE OWM" />

==History==
[[File:TIEShuttle-ESBHD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Captain Needa's TIE/sh departs from the ''Avenger''{{'s}} hangar bay to the ''Executor''.]]
The ship design that would become the TIE/sh evolved from several [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bombers]] that Sienar Fleet Systems [[TIE bomber-shuttle conversion|converted]] into shuttles to carry workers across the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] during its construction. Because the shuttles mainly served utility roles, the Imperial Navy requested a shuttle specifically for command purposes; however, Sienar had already been commissioned and funded to produce the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] for that role.<ref name="TIE OWM" />

Sienar instead answered the Navy's request with a further modified TIE shuttle, with more comfortable seating and distinct outwards-facing wings. The Navy accepted this design, seeing that it was a distinct improvement from the TIE bomber and its previous shuttle conversions.<ref name="TIE OWM" />

Following the [[Battle of Hoth]], [[Captain]] [[Lorth Needa]] used a TIE/sh to travel from his [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Avenger]]'', to the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Executor]]'' to personally apologize to [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] for losing the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' in battle. Vader subsequently [[Death|executed]] him.<ref name="ESB" />
